$comment: Code the characterization suite cannot reach. Each entry names a file, an istanbul kind (statement, branch, function) and the source text at the uncovered location, plus why no input can execute it. check.mjs treats a matching location as covered and fails when an entry matches nothing, so the list cannot go stale.

old.reason: solve(): the pivot fallback needs an exact zero pivot; the within-class covariance carries a 1e-6 ridge on its diagonal, so elimination never cancels to exactly zero.
solve(): the back-substitution fallback needs an exact zero diagonal after elimination; same ridge argument.

Cannot be false: rows are filtered to finite features, the difference vector is non-zero (checked one line above) and the ridged covariance is positive definite, so the solved Fisher vector is finite and non-zero.
The sign flip needs fisher·difference < 0, i.e. dᵀW⁻¹d < 0, impossible for a positive-definite W.
Body of the unreachable sign flip above.
Arrow inside the unreachable sign flip above.

In practice never false: after the eigenvectors, the five unit vectors are appended as candidates and at least four of them are independent of any single Fisher axis, so orthogonalize (norm > 1e-6) always completes the basis.
